planning.actions: same real engine resource actions; selected lines protect their final recruited identity only while safe; polluted units are never protected; visible missing required core or last forming identity cancels reroll only while safe
planning.survivalScale: 0 if hp/maxHp<.3 with shield<10, or <=2 encounter spins remain and enemy HP exceeds .9 × last observed damage × remaining spins, or last encounter spin; .25 if hp/maxHp<.55 with shield<15 or <=2 encounter spins; otherwise1. No hidden RNG or future board used.
planning.skip: retained as a real competing action
planning.adaptive: first visible offer chooses 2/3 lines; >=10 spins retain at most2; >=12 with a formed line retain only formed plus one >=0.6-progress backup; >=18 with no formed retain one; >=2 formed retain two; >=6 spins under critical health or trailing deadline drop unformed lines below .7 progress, retaining at least one

interpretation.power: 真实引擎标准敌阵探针：实伤 + 0.36 ×（实治疗 + min(25,实格挡+减伤) − 自伤）
interpretation.growth: 本次探针实际新增永久培养；攻击者转为威力，支援转为标记职能效能；不混入当前战力
interpretation.progression: 成型前后摘要使用同转仍在对局基线均值作分母；byTurn另外并列全样本进度。v1历史校准的阶段摘要使用全样本基线分母，不能直接跨协议比较
interpretation.allSample: 全样本平均：死亡当转及以后记0；胜利后保持终局战力；全样本进度与只统计仍在对局样本并列
interpretation.intervention: 同一状态、同一探针种子，仅关闭目标套路效果；测即时机制贡献，不能推断通关率因果
interpretation.conditional: 成型后表现、成型事件窗口和成型/未成型胜率属于观察性关联；同时报告未成型失败及各转幸存人数
interpretation.intervals: 胜率与成型率为Wilson95%；战力/成型回合为以每局为单位的均值正态95%区间；小样本不保证正态近似，n<2不报区间
interpretation.thresholds: 0.6规则检查要求无未完成局、同状态套路贡献不为负、无套路自动永久成长；它只验证规则边界，不代表通关难度或所有套路等强。0.5的成长补偿门槛已不适用
